scientific_question: On the original FAS-00 qualification corpus and grouped split, does final-position readout change exact-target transfer relative to the existing FAS_FEATURE_V1 mean_full readout?
hypothesis_status: Diagnostic comparison only; no promotion threshold or pass criterion.

corpus.full_model_input: Exact token IDs and lengths already recorded in the sealed FAS-00 Phase 2A FULL row receipts; do not retokenize or alter input text.
corpus.label_and_latent_fields_to_extractor: FORBIDDEN; the extractor does not deserialize the Phase 1 event labels or latent world state.

split_and_transfer.transfer_train_rows: Training rows with non-null observation_text, context_term_id != 3, and entity_term_id != 7.
split_and_transfer.test_context_slice: Test rows with non-null observation_text and context_term_id == 3.
split_and_transfer.test_entity_slice: Test rows with non-null observation_text and entity_term_id == 7.
split_and_transfer.row_identity_binding: event_id and Phase 1 JSONL row index; exact target is canonical candidate identity index 0=safe, 1=risky, 2=idle.

views.source: Read-only FAS-00 Phase 2A FULL feature rows at even row indices.
views.pooling: FAS_FEATURE_V1 arithmetic mean over all model-visible positions

views.source: New S02-only final hidden state extraction from the same sealed FULL token-ID sequences.
views.pooling: none; select hidden state at sequence_length - 1

view_contract.output_row_order: Phase 1 v03 event JSONL order; source FULL feature row 2*i maps to output final-position row i.
view_contract.forward_batching: one row per forward; exact length; no padding; no mixed-length batch
view_contract.repeat_sample: Sort event IDs by SHA-256 of UTF-8 'FAS_S02_FINAL_REPEAT_V01\0' || event_id; repeat the first 32 distinct events twice and require token/feature byte identity.
view_contract.mismatch_action: FAIL_CLOSED; preserve inputs and stop without fitting probes.

existing_mean_full_probe.action: Load read-only and reproduce its original test predictions/metrics. Do not refit this reference probe.

final_position_probe.model: Multinomial linear softmax logits Wx+b; argmax with lowest-class tie break.
final_position_probe.objective: Mean multiclass cross entropy + (1.0/2) * squared Frobenius norm of W; bias unregularized.
final_position_probe.standardization: Per-dimension training-row mean and population standard deviation; divide by max(std, 1e-6); no other transform.
final_position_probe.optimizer: Deterministic full-batch float64 SciPy L-BFGS-B with analytic gradient, all-zero initialization, maxiter=1000, maxfun=1000000, maxcor=10, maxls=20, gtol=1e-8, ftol=0.0.
final_position_probe.convergence: Require solver success, finite parameters/objective/gradient, and gradient infinity norm <= 1e-8. No retry or alternate solver.

linear_readout.fit_rows_and_labels: The exact transfer_train_rows above; labels are exact_target from the sealed qualification events.

forbidden: S01 corpus, feature, probe, prediction, or metric reuse as an S02 fitting input
online readout, episodic memory, snapshots, recurrent state, RTRL, JEPA, or any adaptive mechanism
backbone training, LoRA, quantization, or parameter writes
